title: feat(plugin-email): every email template can read the deployment address as {{baseUrl}}
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FmGStMcMy7DmcRanYR7nCt)_
Fixes #29095

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：邮件模板的默认上下文新增固定键 `baseUrl`（与 `appName` 并列），模板可写 `{{baseUrl}}/OBJECT/ID` 生成绝对链接。
- 为什么改：执行裁决 A（director 记录 6573566446）：元数据应用此前拿不到部署地址，邮件里无法给出可点的记录链接。
- 风险与回滚：只增不拒；每封模板邮件的上下文多一个键，发送方自带的 `data.baseUrl` 仍然优先。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/capability-arg.ts`（`resolveDeploymentBaseUrl` 的优先级链），`packages/cli/src/commands/serve-email-base-url-parity.test.ts`（与 serve 的地址链对齐的钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/capability-arg.base-url.test.ts`，预期 10 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `resolveEmailCapabilityArg` (`@objectstack/plugin-email`) resolves a `baseUrl` key into the default template context, after the author's context spread, exactly as `appName` is. Chain: `OS_AUTH_URL` (its legacy `BETTER_AUTH_URL`) > `OS_BASE_URL` > `config.email.defaultTemplateContext.baseUrl` > `http://localhost:PORT` (`OS_PORT` > `PORT` > `3000`, the default `serve`'s `--port` flag reads). Trailing slashes are trimmed.
- **Mirror, not a second authority.** The chain's source is `resolveAuthBaseUrl` in `@objectstack/cli` `serve.ts`, which plugin-email cannot import (the CLI depends on it; no new dependency edge). The helper is module-private and its docblock names the source; the new CLI test `serve-email-base-url-parity.test.ts` drives both readers over the same environment through `resolveCapabilityArgument` (the call `serve` makes) and goes red when either chain moves. The mirror keeps the source's `??` semantics: a set-but-empty `OS_AUTH_URL` is a value, as in `serve` (which warns about it at boot).
- Merge order measured: `EmailService` spreads the send's `data` over `defaultTemplateContext` (`email-service.ts`, the `data` object built before `requireVars`), so a send's own `baseUrl` still wins. Pinned in the new test.
- Docs: `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` gains a section on `appName` and `baseUrl`, with one example (`{{baseUrl}}/crm_deal/{{deal.id}}` in `bodyText`), saying the path after the prefix is the application's own.
- No new config key, no generic env carrier for `defaultTemplateContext`, no spec change (ruling A).

## Tests

- New `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/capability-arg.base-url.test.ts` (10 tests): each link of the chain in order, the local default's port, trailing-slash trim from every link, the set-but-empty case, `appName` unchanged (control), a rendered template producing `https://crm.example.com/x/1` in text and html, and a send's own `data.baseUrl` winning.
- New `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-email-base-url-parity.test.ts` (8 rows): `resolveAuthBaseUrl` and the email capability argument agree on every env combination.
- **Forced test edits** (exact-shape `toEqual` on the context, which now carries `baseUrl`): `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-email-appname-precedence.test.ts` (4 expectations gain `baseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000'`, one title renamed from "only appName" to "only the resolved keys"); `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/capability-arg.config-parity.contract.test.ts` (1 expectation gains the same key).

## Acceptance notes

- **`bodyHtml` cannot build an anchor `href` from `baseUrl`.** Measured with `judgeMailHtmlHoles` (`@objectstack/formula`): an `href` value of `{{baseUrl}}/x/{{id}}` is judged `url-attribute`, unsupported, and so is `{{{baseUrl}}}/x/1` (not the whole-value `type: 'url'` shape); the authoring doors refuse both (`email-template-hole-placement`). So the prefix delivers a link in `bodyText` and `subject`, and as element text in `bodyHtml`; an anchor link still needs the whole URL in a `type: 'url'` variable. The docs say exactly this rather than advertise an `href` use. Whether the placement rule should admit a `baseUrl` prefix is a spec/lint-lane question, raised in the report.
- The generated reference `content/docs/references/system/email-config.mdx` (from the spec's `.describe()` on `defaultTemplateContext`) says the context is "passed through unchanged except appName"; it now also resolves `baseUrl`. That text lives in `packages/spec` (spec lane), so it is not edited here; raised in the report.
- Not mirrored, because the email reader cannot know them: the `https` tail of an in-process TLS listener and a dev port that auto-shifted off a busy one. Both affect only the unconfigured local default.

Restored by the tool, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg B (dist, CLI parity pin): reordered the env links to `OS_BASE_URL ?? OS_AUTH_URL ?? BETTER_AUTH_URL`, rebuilt plugin-email, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 2 built files; `serve-email-base-url-parity.test.ts` 3 failed | 5 passed (`expected 'https://base.example.com'` vs auth/legacy).
